newsitem.title: CHINA: Heavy rain eases north China drought.
newsitem.headline: Heavy rain eases north China drought.

text.p: Heavy rains on Friday and Saturday will help to ease a serious drought that has gripped much of northern China for the last few weeks, state media said on Sunday.
Heavy rains had fallen across Beijing as well as the provinces of Shaanxi, Shanxi, Henan and Hebei, the Xinhua news agency said.
"The rainfall will help ease the serious drought that has plagued the northern areas for the past month," it said.
"It will of course be good for the crops," it quoted experts at the Central Meteorology Station as saying.
Precipitation since June has been reported to be 40 to 60 percent lower than normal for the same period in previous years. More than 20 million hectares of farmland had been affected by July 15.
Meteorologists forecast torrential rains for parts of northern, northeastern and central China in the next two to three days.
Officials have said the drought in northern areas would affect this year's corn crop but would not cut the overall grain harvest below forecast levels of about 484 million tonnes for the year.
